name: Hold to Confirm Button
description: A hold-to-confirm button for destructive actions: a fill sweeps across with the label inverting at its edge, springs back if released early and shakes on confirm.
usage:
import { HoldConfirmButton } from "@/components/design-for-ai/button-hold-confirm";

<HoldConfirmButton
  label="Hold to delete project"
  doneLabel="Deleted"
  duration={1200}
  onConfirm={() => api.projects.delete(id)} // return a promise for pending + error states
/>

<HoldConfirmButton variant="neutral" size="sm" label="Archive" doneLabel="Archived" />

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs at 100%. Return a promise to show the pending state; reject it to show the error state.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long to hold, in ms.

props.name: variant
props.description: Red fill for destructive actions, near-white fill for reversible ones.

props.name: size
props.description: 36px or 44px tall. sm keeps a 44px hit area.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: Label while an async onConfirm is in flight.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label once confirmed, with a drawn check.

props.name: hint
props.description: Tooltip after a quick tap, so people learn it's a hold.

props.name: announcement
props.description: Read to screen readers on success. Defaults to doneLabel.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Defaults to a trash can (danger) or archive box (neutral); null hides it.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Ms after success before it resets; null stays confirmed.
